clause: GPU render-path wiring for effects: RenderEngine binding, EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE, CPU fallback promotion-equivalence, headless/quiet [STU-FX-036,STU-FX-038,STU-FX-018]

scope.summary: Wire every filter/effect through the studio-engine RenderEngine (wgpu/WGSL) driven by StudioRenderHarness: GPU-Req rows run on a supported backend or return a determinate EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE state (harness records shortfall, never silent empty output); Opt rows carry a CPU fallback producing promotion-equivalent output; GPU deps stay isolated in studio-engine (never in handshake_core Cargo.toml). Batch/model-driven application runs headless and quiet (14.20): no foreground window, no focus/input steal; interactive group-12 workspaces expose an equivalent headless typed-data path.
acceptance_criteria: RenderEngine/StudioRenderHarness binding; GPU-Req -> determinate unavailable state; Opt CPU fallback equivalent; GPU dep isolated; headless+quiet
proof_targets: real-GPU render + headless EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE fallback + quiet negative test
expected_tests: real-GPU: GPU-Req effect renders through RenderEngine; headless fallback: no-GPU returns EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE (AccessKit-tree assert, not empty)
test: Opt effect CPU fallback promotion-equivalent to GPU within tolerance
negative: batch effect run pops no window / steals no focus; handshake_core Cargo.toml has no wgpu/wgsl

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: GPU effects silently empty or leak GPU dep into core; agent runs steal focus.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
